new.title: New TODO
f.title: Title
f.folder.bad: Choose a folder, or type an absolute path.
f.tags.long: Keep each tag to {{max}} characters or fewer.
o.deduped: You already have this TODO open: #{{num}}
o.dedupedBody: Nothing new was added: an open TODO with the same title, details and folder is kept as one.
o.picked: Marked #{{num}} as the TODO you added
o.unsureBody: Check again lists open TODOs with this title, details and folder made around the time you pressed Add. It never adds it again.
o.readFailed: The TODOs could not be read. Try Check again later.
cand.none: No open TODO with these words was made around then. That doesn't rule it out: it may still arrive, or it was kept as an older open TODO with the same words.
cand.match_one: One open TODO with these words was made around then. It may be yours, or one made another way.
cand.match_other: {{count}} open TODOs with these words were made around then. Pick the one you added, if any.
ask.title: Ask the agent to make a TODO
ask.help: The agent makes it in a new conversation in the Agent panel.
ask.ex.backups: check that last night's backups finished
ask.ex.deps: update the project's dependencies and run the tests
ask.ex.disk: clean up old logs when the disk gets full
ask.panel: Write it in the Agent panel instead
ask.notSent: Nothing was sent. Nothing reached the agent. Your words are kept: send them again.
ask.unknown: This may have gone through. Check the Agent panel before you send it again.
ask.late: Your words did not reach the agent on {{computer}}
ask.lateBody: Nothing was sent. Put them in the Agent panel to send them again.
ask.lateGo: Put them in the Agent panel
f.repeat: This may already be added: an earlier Add of this title, details and folder got no answer. Change one of them to add another.
